payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Florencio, Robena, Salvador, Wenona

payload.content: Hello team, I have 4 hours available and strong skills in data-science. I am considering tasks related to ISSUE-0001 since they align with my skills and availability. I notice ISSUE-0002 tasks have high priority but are too costly and require more effort than I can provide.
I am considering ISSUE-0001::implement or ISSUE-0001::test tasks. Would like to know if anyone else has preferences to avoid duplication.

Hello team, I have 4 hours available and my top skill is data-science with a very high match. I am considering tasks related to ISSUE-0001 since they align well with my skills and availability. I see Robena is interested in ISSUE-0001::implement and ISSUE-0001::test. To avoid duplication, I am leaning towards either ISSUE-0001::review, ISSUE-0001::docs, or ISSUE-0001::triage as they have lower cost and effort and fit my skill set.

Hello team, Wenona here. I have 6 hours available and strong skills in data-science. Considering the high priority but costly ISSUE-0002 tasks, I will likely avoid them due to their high cost relative to my availability. I am looking at the ISSUE-0001 tasks as well, especially the review, docs, or triage tasks since they align well with my skills and availability and have lower costs. If others are interested in the implement or test tasks, I can take one of the lower cost tasks to avoid duplication.

Hello all, Wenona joining the discussion. To avoid duplicated task choices and optimize our sprint, I propose I take one of the ISSUE-0001 tasks such as review, docs, or triage, which match my skills and availability well. I see Robena and Florencio are already considering implement and test tasks or review/docs/triage, so I will coordinate with them to ensure no overlaps.

Wenona here. To coordinate efficiently, I will leave ISSUE-0001::implement and ISSUE-0001::test tasks to Robena and Florencio since they prefer those. I will consider ISSUE-0001::review or docs or triage based on who else claims what. Please share your final preferences soon so we avoid overlaps.

Hello team, Salvador here. I have 5 hours available and strong skills in data-science and frontend. I see Robena is interested in ISSUE-0001::implement and ISSUE-0001::test, Florencio and Wenona are leaning towards review, docs, or triage tasks. To optimize our sprint, I am considering ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage since they align well with my skills and availability. Please share your final preferences so we avoid overlaps.

Hello team, Salvador joining the discussion. I acknowledge Robena, Florencio, and Wenona have good coverage of ISSUE-0001 tasks. I am considering taking ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage to complement the team's current selections and avoid duplication. Please confirm your choices soon for efficient coordination.

Hello team, I see Florencio is considering review, docs, or triage for ISSUE-0001, and Wenona and Salvador are also leaning towards these. I will prioritize ISSUE-0001::implement or ISSUE-0001::test as planned, and I kindly ask Florencio, Wenona, and Salvador to finalize who takes which from review, docs, triage to avoid overlap. Let's confirm soon!

Hello team, Florencio here. I see Robena is focusing on ISSUE-0001::implement and test. I am considering ISSUE-0001::review, docs, or triage tasks as they fit my skills and cost preferences. Wenona and Salvador, please let me know your final preferences for these tasks so we can avoid overlaps and maximize our sprint efficiency.

Hello team, Wenona here. Considering the ongoing preferences, I propose Florencio takes ISSUE-0001::review, Salvador takes ISSUE-0001::docs, and I will take ISSUE-0001::triage. This way we avoid duplication and efficiently cover these tasks. Robena can focus on ISSUE-0001::implement or test as planned. Please confirm or suggest adjustments.
Wenona confirms readiness to take ISSUE-0001::triage as part of coordinated task allocation to avoid overlaps and maximize sprint coverage. Awaiting team confirmation on this distribution.

Salvador agrees with the proposed distribution: Florencio takes ISSUE-0001::review, Salvador takes ISSUE-0001::docs, and Wenona takes ISSUE-0001::triage. Robena focuses on ISSUE-0001::implement or test. This coordination avoids duplication and efficiently covers the tasks.
